# optimizelycmssaas Provider

Manage Optimizely CMS (SaaS) via its REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    optimizelycmssaas = {
      source = "willemharingopti/optimizelycmssaas" # replace with your registry address
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from the environment (recommended; keeps the secret out of config and state):
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMS_CLIENT_ID=...        # the API client's NAME
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMS_CLIENT_SECRET=...
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMS_BASE_URL=https://api.cms.optimizely.com   # optional
provider "optimizelycmssaas" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_version` (String) REST API version, such as v1 or v2. Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMS_API_VERSION. Default v1, the version this provider is built and tested against: other versions may differ and are used at your own risk.
- `base_url` (String) API host, https only; the API version is added for you (a trailing /vN is accepted and used as the version unless api_version is set). Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMS_BASE_URL. Default https://api.cms.optimizely.com
- `client_id` (String) API client name, as shown when the API client was created. Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMS_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) API client secret. Prefer env OPTIMIZELY_CMS_CLIENT_SECRET so it stays out of config/state.
- `content_root_key` (String) Key of the root of the content tree, used by the optimizelycmssaas_content_root data source. Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMS_CONTENT_ROOT_KEY. Default 43f936c99b234ea397b261c538ad07c9, the built-in root observed on every instance checked. A key with dashes is accepted. When set, that key is used or the lookup fails; it never falls back to another one.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth token URL (https only). Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMS_TOKEN_URL. Default <base_url>/oauth/token.
